summary.text: Kevin Petersen is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Assembly representing District 57, based in Waupaca, and has been elected to the Assembly since 2006.
He is the Speaker Pro Tempore and co-chair of the Law Revision Committee.

paragraphs.text: Petersen was born in Waupaca, Wisconsin, on December 14, 1964, and is married with two children.
He graduated from Waupaca High School in 1983 and earned a B.S.M.E. from the University of New Mexico in 1989.
The Legislature's page lists him as the owner of a family-run electronics corporation.
It says he served in the U.S. Navy submarine service from 1983 to 1994, is a Persian Gulf War veteran, and was a member of the U.S. Naval Reserve from 1994 to 2008.
He was elected to the Town of Dayton Board as a supervisor from 2001 to 2007, and his Assembly leadership roles are Assistant Majority Leader in 2021 and Speaker Pro Tempore in 2023 and 2025.
